description: Publishes files to a live permanent URL at a slug. Inputs: files (required), and optional slug, spa, ttl_seconds, merge, expected_version, and token. Paths are stored exactly. Returns url, path_url, slug, version, and token on the first anonymous publish. On deed.page, url and path_url are both https://{slug}.deed.page/. A lost token has no recovery unless an optional recovery email was attached. When expected_version does not match the live version, the result is version_conflict and nothing is written. A racing publish of the same slug returns version_conflict even without expected_version. Malware, executables, and credential-harvesting pages return content_rejected and are not stored. .bin is blocked by file type (it often has no MZ or ELF header). A raw octet-stream body is screened as one file.

expected_version.description: Live version this write is based on, such as "v3". If the slug is no longer at that version, the result is version_conflict and nothing is written. A racing publish of the same slug returns version_conflict even when this is omitted.

files.description:
Path map, or an array of {path, content} or {path, base64}. Paths are stored exactly as given (a single top-level directory is not removed). Text as a string, binary as {"base64":"..."}. Example: {"index.html":"

Hi

","img/logo.png":{"base64":"iVBOR..."}}. Any other array is rejected.

merge.description: Add or overwrite only these exact paths on the existing site. Paths omitted from this call are left unchanged. Nothing is moved to the site root.

slug.description: Exact slug matching ^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$ (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, 1-63, no leading or trailing hyphen). Invalid slugs return slug_invalid and are not rewritten. Reserved names (hello, my-page, www, api, docs, admin, mcp, blog, app, status, and other docs examples) return slug_reserved on a new claim. A token that already owns one can still update it. Omit for a random slug.

spa.description: Serve index.html for unknown paths (single-page apps).

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

ttl_seconds.description: Opt-in expiry in seconds. Omit for a permanent site.

name: publish_site
title: Publish a site
